senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; כָּתַת)oil gained from pounded olives.
units: Ib. 86ᵇ אין כ׳ אלא כָּתוּשׁ the Biblical kathith means pounded. [Ib. 53ᵇ, v. preced.].

senses.gloss: pl. כְּתִיתִין (sub. פַּת, v. preced.) bread or pastry made of pounded wheat, delicacies.
units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 15:2">Midr. Till. to Ps. XV, 1</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 664:1">Yalk. Ps. 664</cite> <he>שמוכרין מיני כ׳ וכל דבר</he> [<cite ref="I00107"><he>טוב</he></cite>] who had for sale various fine pastries and all sorts of [good]things.

senses.gloss: (cmp. b. h. ספחת) scab on an animal’s back from friction.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 8:1">Sabb. VIII, 1</cite> (<cite ref="Shabbat 76b:6">76ᵇ</cite>) <he>דבש כדי ליתן על פי כ׳</he> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) honey, as much as required for putting on a scab (v. <cite ref="K01363"><he>כְּתִישָׁא</he></cite>); ib. 77ᵇ, v. <cite ref="M00674"><he>מוֹרְשָׁא</he></cite> a. <cite ref="E00212"><he>הוֹדְרנָא</he></cite>. Ib. <he>ברא שבלול לכ׳</he> He created the snail as a remedy for a scab; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 9:2:5">Y. Ber. IX, 13ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>שבלון לכ׳</he> ed. Lehm. (ed. <he>לחזיות</he>, v. <cite ref="H00522"><he>חְזָזִית</he></cite>).

senses.gloss: (also כָּתוּת) compress of rags (cmp. שְׁחָקִים, בְּלָיוֹת); pad. [Tosef. Mikv. VI, 10 כתות של גדיל, v. כָּשׁוּת.]—Pl. כְּתִיתִים, כְּתִיתִין, כְּתוּ׳.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 12:14">Tosef. Sabb. XII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 13:14">XIII</cite>), 14; <cite ref="Shabbat 134b:22">Sabb. 134ᵇ</cite> <he>כ׳ יבשין</he> dry compresses.

<cite ref="Shabbat 53a">Ib. 53ᵃ</cite> <he>כ׳ ע״ג השבר</he> Ms. M. (ed. <cite ref="S02253"><he>קשישין</he></cite>, Ms. O. <cite ref="K00090"><he>כַּבְשִׁישִׁין</he></cite>) pads upon a fractured limb.

<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 6:8">Ib. VI, 8</cite> (<cite ref="Shabbat 66a:15">66ᵃ</cite>); <cite ref="Yoma 78b:3">Yoma 78ᵇ</cite> <he>אם יש לו בית קבול כתי׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <cite ref="K01363"><he>כתו׳</he></cite>) if the wooden leg has a cavity for the reception of pads, v. <cite ref="K01366">next w.</cite>
